q: What are the emissions from processing lac into shellac?
title: Lac to shellac: processing emissions
short: Stick lac is crushed, washed, dried and melted into shellac. Emissions come from electricity for crushers and washers, and fuel for melting and drying. Lac itself is a natural resin, so its carbon is biogenic. Record fuel and power per kg of shellac made.

ol: Melting and filtering to shellac flakes.

p: Units on the electricity bill, fuel bought for melting, and kilograms of seedlac and shellac produced each month.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
